### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/service-analytics`, touching **13** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`  _(via COPY (symbol, a top-level const object))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 348340734a935b304af47824cb20ece502869757` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6470a6dc6f986504b2cb2589a7078223587354d7` — the merge of head `9c885ebac598533a4c07ba9ef2709bc28147b1c8` into base `348340734a935b304af47824cb20ece502869757`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6470a6dc6f986504b2cb2589a7078223587354d7 && git checkout 6470a6dc6f986504b2cb2589a7078223587354d7
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 348340734a935b304af47824cb20ece502869757 9c885ebac598533a4c07ba9ef2709bc28147b1c8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 348340734a935b304af47824cb20ece502869757 && git merge --no-ff 9c885ebac598533a4c07ba9ef2709bc28147b1c8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 348340734a935b304af47824cb20ece502869757
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 348340734a935b304af47824cb20ece502869757` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

**L1 full · REWORK (PR body only; the code has nothing to fix)** · Head-sha: `9c885ebac598533a4c07ba9ef2709bc28147b1c8` · card #35005 · read 2026-11-18T09:01Z

Net diff against merge base `aef42cba4e`: 6 files, +286 / -28, one commit. Not governed. Draft, targets `main`. Merges cleanly onto origin/main `a6cf988eb3`, and main has not touched the three source files since the base.

### Must fix

- **M1. `Fixes #35005` must become `Part of #35005`.** The card's second Done-when item is: "The door strings, the ADR note and the skill state the scoped rule in the same words." This PR changes the two door strings only. The claim (6972020316) correctly kept `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**` off an implementation card's file surface, and #35158 carries them. That means this PR lands the implementable half of the card, and the checklist rule is `Part of`. With `Fixes`, the merge would close a p1 card whose ADR and skill sentences still contradict the door. Use the safe spelling, with no verb next to the card number, and write the closing arrangement in a comment. The seat can make this edit; the code needs no dev round. After the edit I re-read the body only.

### Should fix (seat-side, not this diff)

- **S1. Priority and order of #35158.** #35158 is filed `priority:p2`, but it carries the open half of a p1 card. Under the maintainer's p1-only intake it would wait indefinitely while the ask skill tells clients to ask about every word with `candidates`. That skill is shipped in `@objectstack/mcp` itself as `ask-skill.generated.ts` and served at `GET /mcp/skill`, and the door now says "never ask about it". As a card that blocks a p1, it qualifies under 「暂时只处理 p1 和 阻塞 p1 的卡」. Mark it as #35005's blocker (or p1) so it gets worked; it needs no new claim beyond #35005's own carry. Landing order also matters. #35100's added line "When the answer has `nextStep`, follow its `decision` and `note`" makes the note win over the old table row, so if #35100 lands before this PR, the stretch until #35158 lands is covered by the skill's own text.
- **S2. The card's "Eval cases" scope item has no carrier.** The PR body explains why it is absent: there is no dataset eval set in `service-analytics`, and `docs/qa/scenarios/*.json` belongs to the eval seat. But no card or comment takes it over. Name one: a line on #35158, or a card for the eval seat with the two cases the card lists (a matched measure beside a candidate on another word, and a dimension-only candidate).

### Checked, holds

- **The narrowing reading** (claim 6972020316) follows the card's Why and Done-when. Only words whose candidates are all dimensions change. A word with a measure among its candidates is still asked about beside a matched measure, and still computes nothing when nothing matched. It is recorded in the claim, and it does not take the literal first clause of Scope.
- **Ruling #34691 F1 = B** ("near candidates for asking back only, never selected; what counts as a match does not change"). `readTerm` still decides from `matches` and `offered` exactly as before. The only addition is `groupingOnly = decision === 'candidates_only' && offered.every((m) => m.kind === 'dimensions')`, and `kind` was already on what `memberOf` returns. `decision`, `terms`, `matches` and `candidates` are unchanged for every input. The note offers the dimension; the executor never selects it.
- **Spec:** `DatasetNextStepDecision` says "Each value names what the platform FOUND … none names what a reader then does … the text that carries it to a model is the executor's". A note-only change leaves every published decision definition true. Open question option A (a lone grouping-only word stays `candidates_only`) is consistent with the published `no_measure` = "has no entry in `candidates`". `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right.
- **Sentence paths in `composeDatasetNextStep`.**
  - Under `one_measure`, asked words come first with `leftCandidateTail`, then the offered groupings with `groupingCandidateTail`, then unknown words and grouping-hit words.
  - Under `candidates_only`, `candidateTail` ("compute nothing until they answer") is emitted only when at least one reported word has a measure candidate. When every reported word is grouping-only, `groupingTail` ("ask which number") is emitted once, and `leftOutSentences` never adds a second.
  - The four locales carry the same two new strings.
- **Door strings.** `LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION` and `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` carry the identical sentence "A word whose candidates are all dimensions is at most a possible grouping: never ask about it, and it never stops a matched measure." Both scope the ask-back to "a measure among its candidates". The mcp test reads the real description from `getDatasetToolDefinitions()`, so the two doors cannot drift apart.
- **Tests.**
  - The 7 `[#35005]` pins cover 按行业 + 销售额, this quarter / 本季度, bare 销售, revenue + churn, a word with mixed candidates, both kinds at once, and a lone grouping word. Each of the pins that the dev report says covers all four locales does.
  - The one-time ablation (`groupingOnly = false`) turned the 4 grouping pins red and left the controls green, which is the right split. It was restored, and the restored blob equals HEAD.
- **Changeset** (this PR's own file, `@objectstack/service-analytics` and `@objectstack/mcp` patch), read sentence by sentence against the diff. The 按行业 / this quarter cases, "a bare near-miss measure word … is still `candidates_only` and computes nothing", "What changes is the note only", the lone-word behaviour and the identical door sentence all hold. No `content/docs/releases/` path is touched, and no changeset already on main is edited.
- **Gates at this head.** 53 check-runs, all completed, none failed. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (all 10 shards), `Build Core`, `Check Changeset`, the PR-body guards and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are `success`. The UI and docs jobs were skipped by filter.

### Nits (no change asked)

- "this quarter" and 本季度 are time filters, not groupings. The note offers them as "a possible grouping: Quarter" and then says "group the answer only as the question asks", which keeps the model from grouping by quarter when the question only bounds the time. This reading is the card's own ("at most offered as a grouping"), and it is worth keeping in mind for #35158's wording.

### Not mine, still owed before landing

- M1 (the body edit), then my body-only re-read.
- The contract review the seat is running at this head.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `9c885ebac598533a4c07ba9ef2709bc28147b1c8`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #35005 body and its three comments (triage 6963243189, claim 6972020316 with the narrowing Premise, dev report 6973197402); PR #35156 body, file list (6 files, +286/-28), the net diff against merge-base `aef42cba4e`, and its PR comments; the 53 check-runs on this head (37 success, 16 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending). Code outside the diff read at this head only to judge the claims: `packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts` (`DatasetNextStepDecision`, `DatasetNextStepSchema`, `DatasetTermCandidateSchema`, `ListDatasetsOutputSchema.candidates`), `dataset-term-matcher.ts` (`findDatasetTermCandidates`), the #34691 F1 = B ruling (6943107981), and follow-up #35158.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff changes no accepted input and no output shape. It changes three texts that reach a model: the `nextStep.note` the executor writes, the `list_datasets` tool description, and the MCP `initialize` selection rule. Each is judged below.

1. **`readTerm` / `groupingOnly` (`dataset-next-step.ts`). Right.** `groupingOnly` is `decision === 'candidates_only' && offered.every(kind === 'dimensions')`. A `candidates_only` decision implies `offered.length > 0`, so the empty-`every` case cannot occur. `kind` is the pointer prefix that `memberOf` already returned, and `findDatasetTermCandidates` writes it as `measures` or `dimensions`, so the comparison is exact. `decision`, `terms`, `matches` and `candidates` are computed exactly as before, so the wire output differs only in `note`. That agrees with the claim and the changeset.
2. **The note, by reading. Right for every reading.**
   - *All-dimension candidates beside a matched measure* (「按行业」+销售额, "this quarter"+revenue, 本季度+销售额): the decision is `one_measure`, and the `leftOutSentences` reading is `groupingCandidateHit` + `groupingCandidateTail`, with no ask-first sentence. This meets the Done-when's first half and is pinned in four locales.
   - *All-dimension candidates with no matched measure* (a lone "this quarter"): the decision stays `candidates_only`. The note offers the grouping, says not to ask about it, then adds the existing `groupingTail`, which asks which number is meant. That question is about the missing measure (D3 rule 5), not about the word, so it does not contradict "never ask about it". With an unknown word beside it, the fallback tail follows, the same pairing the `no_measure` branch already used.
   - *Mixed kinds* (a measure and a dimension among one word's candidates): `groupingOnly` is false, so the word is asked about, both beside a matched measure (`leftCandidateTail`) and alone (`candidateTail`, compute nothing). This matches the door words "a word with a measure among its candidates: ask".
   - *Measure-only candidates*: unchanged. Bare 销售 is still `candidates_only` with compute-nothing in four locales, and revenue+churn still asks about churn in four locales. This meets the Done-when's second half ("a bare near-miss measure word still asks").
   - *Both kinds across two words*: the ask-first sentence comes before the grouping offer. Under `candidates_only`, `candidateTail` (compute nothing) and `groupingCandidateTail` both appear. They do not conflict, because there is no matched measure to stop.
   - *Under `several_measures`*: the note has no left-out tail, so a grouping-only word is neither named nor asked about. This is unchanged and consistent with the rule.
   - *Every locale*: `en`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` and `ja` each carry both new strings with the same three parts: not a question, not a stop, group only as the question asks. An unlisted locale falls back to `en` through the unchanged `datasetToolSentenceLocale`.
3. **`LIST_DATASETS_DESCRIPTION` and `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE`. Right.** Both carry the scoped sentence character for character: "A word whose candidates are all dimensions is at most a possible grouping: never ask about it, and it never stops a matched measure." The mcp pin (`initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`) reads the real description from `getDatasetToolDefinitions`, so the two doors cannot drift apart unnoticed. The executor's note does what that sentence says for every reading in item 2. The ask clause next to it is worded differently in each door: "A word with a measure among its candidates: ask the same way" against "A word with no match and a measure among its candidates in the answer: ask the same way". The two clauses mean the same thing, and the surrounding text already differed before this PR (N1).
4. **Prior rulings. Holds.** What counts as a match is unchanged: no candidate enters `matches`, no decision value moves, and the executor says so in its own module doc. #34691 F1 = B said "for asking back only, never selected". #35005, filed on the maintainer's 「立卡」, scopes that ruling for dimension candidates ("at most offered as a grouping", and its Done-when says "computed, grouped by industry"). The PR implements the card's scope and nothing wider. Measure candidates are still never selected.
5. **A published statement this leaves partly untrue (S1).** `ListDatasetsOutputSchema.candidates` in `packages/spec` describes the list as "Members offered as possible readings … for a clarifying question". `DatasetTermCandidateSchema`'s jsdoc says the same ("offers the member for a clarifying question"). That description is served to every MCP client as `list_datasets`' `outputSchema` (`dataset-tools.ts:151`), next to a note and a tool description that now say a dimension-only candidate is "not a question". The PR does not edit it, and it cannot within its file surface: `packages/spec` is a contract face. But neither the dev's out-of-scope findings nor #35158 names it, so nothing carries it.
6. **Candidate cap (N2).** `findDatasetTermCandidates` lists each dataset's measures before its dimensions, dataset by dataset, and cuts at 5 per term with no marker. A word near five or more dimensions in earlier datasets and a measure in a later one is therefore read as grouping-only. The note still agrees with the words, because the door says "a word whose candidates are all dimensions" and the model sees the same capped list. The edge is narrow and inherited from the published cap, so it does not need a fix here.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset: right.** It is `patch` for `@objectstack/service-analytics` and `@objectstack/mcp`, which are exactly the two released packages the diff changes. The change is a behaviour fix in executor text, and no export is added or removed: `DatasetToolCopy`, `TermReading` and `groupingCandidateSentences` are module-private. The `Check Changeset` run succeeded.
- **`Clause-②: no` holds** on both the PR body and the changeset:
  - There is no new output field: `nextStep` is still `decision`/`terms`/`note`.
  - There is no new enum value.
  - No published value changes meaning. `DatasetNextStepDecision` states that each value "names what the platform FOUND … and none names what a reader then does … the text that carries it to a model is the executor's (M1)". `note` is declared as text whose "wording is the executor's; the schema … fixes no text". Keeping a lone grouping-only word as `candidates_only` is exactly the spec's definition ("matched no member and has entries in `candidates`").
  - The `candidates` description drift in ① item 5 does not change a value either. The list's members and order are unchanged; only its stated purpose is narrower than what a consumer is now told. It is graded S1 below rather than as a Clause-② error.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none` is right.** Nothing a metadata author writes changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev open question (a lone all-dimension word: `candidates_only` or `no_measure`). Answered: A.** Keeping `candidates_only` and scoping only the note agrees with the published definitions. `no_measure` is "has no entry in `candidates`", so relabelling would change a published value's meaning: a Clause-② yes and a spec PR. It also agrees with the card's Done-when, which names only the measure-beside-grouping case and the bare-measure case, and with its Scope ("at most offered as a grouping"). The note for the lone case asks which number is meant, never about the word. The seat reached the same reading (6973789543).
- **Dev out-of-scope finding (ADR-0149 D3 note, `skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md`).** Carried by #35158, which is open, Tier H, and ordered after this PR. It is not owed here. One addition for that card (N3): its item 1 treats rule 1's parenthesis "(it may be offered in rule 3's question, never acted on)" as optional. After this PR the note tells the model to group by a dimension candidate when the question asks for it, so that parenthesis is no longer true for dimension candidates. Changing it is owed, not optional.
- **Dev gate flag: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally.** Answered by CI: every check-run on this head concluded success or skipped, with none failed or pending, so the gate families have their verdict.
- **Claim narrowing (Premise "corrected").** Honoured. Only dimension candidates change, and a word with a measure among its candidates keeps its question. Both sides are pinned, and the dev's ablation turned exactly the four grouping pins red.
- **SQL push-down (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 5).** Not engaged. The diff composes text from an answer that is already in memory. It adds no id materialisation, no query and no in-app join.

**Findings**

S1 (should-fix) — `packages/spec` `ListDatasetsOutputSchema.candidates` ("… for a clarifying question") and `DatasetTermCandidateSchema`'s jsdoc ("offers the member for a clarifying question") now state a purpose that the executor note and both door strings deny for dimension-only candidates. The `outputSchema` text reaches every MCP client. Fixing it in this PR is out of its surface. The fix owed here is a carrier: amend #35158 or file a `domain:spec` card naming both sentences, and the regenerated `content/docs/references/ai/dataset-tools.mdx`, before or at merge.

N1 (nit) — The ask clause beside the shared sentence is worded differently in the two doors. They mean the same thing, and the scoped sentence the card requires is identical and pinned.

N2 (nit) — The per-term cap of 5 (measures before dimensions within each dataset, dataset by dataset) can cut a later dataset's measure candidate and make a word read as grouping-only. The note matches what the answer lists, so this is noted only.

N3 (nit) — #35158 should treat ADR-0149 rule 1's "(… never acted on)" as owed, not optional.

No must-fix.

## 席位核对

**L1 body re-read · ACCEPT** · Head-sha: `9c885ebac598533a4c07ba9ef2709bc28147b1c8` (unchanged since REWORK 6973888624) · card #35005 (`Part of #35005`) · read 2026-11-18T09:06Z

The head commit is the same one my REWORK read, so the code findings in 6973888624 stand. This re-read covers the PR body and the items carried to the card.

### REWORK items

- **M1 closed.**
  - Line 1 of the body is now `Part of #35005`.
  - I scanned the whole body: no closing keyword (close/fix/resolve in any form) appears next to any issue number. The only other mention of #35005 is "#35005 卡面 p1", which has no verb.
  - The closing arrangement is on the card (6973963007): the seat closes #35005 when #35158's PR merges.
- **S1 closed.** #35158 is now `priority:p1` (6973951753), and its Order section sequences it after #35156 and #35100.
- **S2 closed.** #35158 now has an "Eval cases (carried from #35005's scope)" section with both cases the card names.

### Recorded deviation (the seat owns it)

- **The `packages/spec` description stays false until #35158 lands.** `ListDatasetsOutputSchema.candidates` (".. for a clarifying question") and the `DatasetTermCandidateSchema` jsdoc are published spec text, and they are served to MCP clients as `list_datasets`' `outputSchema`.
